FloPlast uPVC round running outlet provides an essential and practical connection for rainwater drainage systems, linking 112mm gutters to 68mm downpipes. These durable white uPVC components are ideal for both new-build projects and refurbishment work onvarious properties, ensuring efficient water diversion. The system features pre-lubricated seals and a pre-fitted gutter seal retaining clip for straightforward installation and a secure, leak-free connection. With good flow capacity and compatibility with most major manufacturers, it offers a long-lasting drainage solution for trade professionals.
